To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) Probabilistic Numeric Neural Networks provide a principled framework for learning with irregularly sampled or missing data, and (b) this framework can be extended to learn steerable equivariant feature representations for irregular data.
we propose Probabilicstic Numeric Convolutional Networks (PNCNNs) that represent feature representations as Gaussian processes and define convolutional layers as the solution to an evolution PDE.

(1) we propose a probabilistic numeric convolutional neural network that is able to deal with continuous inputs, such as images and time series, (2) we provide a theoretical justification for our approach, (3) we show that it can outperform previous approaches in terms of accuracy and (4) we show that our method can be used for time series classification
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following question: Can we use the machinery of probabilistic numerics to define deep learning models that are robust to missing or irregular data?
the development of a probabilistic deep learning approach that is capable of learning from irregularly sampled continuous signals.
the development of deep learning methods for irregularly sampled continuous data.
